benefitRows.name: Swiggy Dineout
benefitRows.description: 20% savings for payments via Dineout Pay.
benefitRows.offer: Get up to 20% savings on payments via Dineout Pay with Best Price Save Smart Credit Card.|Maximum discount per transaction capped at ₹1,000.|Maximum discount per month capped at ₹1,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy or Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the offer at checkout. Complete the payment using your HDFC Best Price Save Smart credit card to enjoy up to 20% savings, with a maximum discount of ₹1,000 per transaction and ₹1,000 per month.
